title: Approval binds one immutable consequential operation
description:
As a household member, I want an approval to authorize exactly what I reviewed, so that an injected model cannot substitute a different action afterward.

Feature: Exact consequential approval

Scenario: Execute the reviewed structured operation
  Given a bot proposes a structured consequential operation with concrete destination and payload
  When the user approves that operation
  Then only the reviewed destination and payload may execute
  And changing either requires a new approval
  And completion evidence identifies the target-system result
